Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs a multi-omics approach including metaproteomics (host and bacterial proteins) and metabolomics. The proteomics part is a standard bottom-up DDA LFQ workflow. While the study discusses mTOR signaling and PTM-related pathways, no specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or acetyl) was performed for the proteomics runs; the PTM-related findings are derived from differential abundance of proteins and transcriptomics.

scope: Vaginal swabs were eluted with PBS (pH 7.0). Swabs were then centrifuged in SpinX tubes with a bonded fritted bottom (Corning, Corning, NY) and eluate was collected. Eluates were centrifuged at 23,000g for 30 min at 4°C and 100μL of supernatant per sample was then denatured, reduced, alkylated and digested into peptides.
